sentences.en: The great difficulties stand in the way of its achievement.
sentences.zh: 这些巨大的困难阻碍了它的实现。

sentences.en: His career as a journalist was full of distinguished achievements.
sentences.zh: 作为一名记者的职业生涯中充满了杰出的成就。

sentences.en: Because of his achievements, he is held in high esteem.
sentences.zh: 由于他的成就，他备受尊敬。

senses.zh: 成就; 成绩; 功绩 - 达到; 完成
